name: Sub Zero — create and draft a single Instagram post
query: Create a Sub Zero Ice Cream Instagram post about our new brown butter bourbon pecan flavor
expected_behavior: Step 1: Call GET /v2/users/me/accounts to discover connected platform account IDs
Step 2: Identify the post type as single post, Instagram primary
Step 3: Write an experiential, visual-first Instagram caption using Sub Zero brand voice
Step 4: Include core brand hashtags (#SubZeroIceCream, #LiquidNitrogenIceCream, #IceCreamExperience, #CustomIceCream, #PremiumIceCream) plus contextual flavor hashtags
Step 5: Ask the user whether to generate a visual for this post
Step 6: Present the draft caption for user review before submitting to Blotato
Step 7: On approval, call POST /v2/posts with the Instagram account ID and caption
Step 9: Append an entry to posts-log.md at repo root with date, platform, post ID, and status
success_criteria: Caption is ≤ 2200 characters and leads with a sensory or experiential hook
All five core brand hashtags are present in the caption
At least 3 contextual flavor hashtags are included
User is shown the draft before any API submission
POST /v2/posts is called with correct platform value 'instagram' and the account ID
posts-log.md is created or updated with the new entry
